programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S04 : E93 Jodha Akbar S4 E93
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Monster Jam Replay
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Delta Center - Salt Lake City, UT
programme.desc: Feel the ground shake as the 2026 Monster Jam season kicks off with a high-octane battle in Salt Lake City. Watch legendary icons like Grave Digger and Megalodon go head-to-head against reigning World Finals champion Blake Granger in Monster Mutt Dalmatian and Armando Castro, who is celebrating 25 years of El Toro Loco. From the precision of the Two-Wheel Skills Challenge to the adrenaline-fueled chaos of a Freestyle finale packed with backflips and drifting, these elite athletes push 12,000-pound machines to their absolute limits.

programme.title: Monster Jam Fast Track
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Snapdragon Stadium - San Diego, CA
programme.desc: High-speed brackets and split-second decisions define this Monster Jam Fast Track showdown as elite drivers push their trucks to the limit in racing and skills competition. Tyler Menninga’s Grave Digger sets the tone early, but relentless pressure from Zombie, El Toro Loco, Megalodon, and Vendetta turns every run into a must-win moment. Clean launches, aggressive cornering, and costly mistakes reshape the leaderboard as rivals trade momentum. With points on the line and no room for error, this episode delivers pure Monster Jam intensity from start to finish.

This pulse-pounding episode features a mix of decorated veterans and hungry rising stars competing in head-to-head JCB Racing, a technical Skills Challenge, and a spectacular Freestyle finale. programme.desc: The final duel of Battle City begins. Yami Marik quickly turns it into a shadow game and sets it up so that if he or the Pharaoh loses, their host's soul will be destroyed. Yugi convinces the Pharaoh not to worry about him and to keep dueling to save Mai, Bakura and the good Marik. Yami Marik quickly discards his Winged Dragon of Ra to the graveyard, planning to revive it. Yugi manages to summon Slifer the Sky Dragon using his three Knights.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E42 The Final Face Off — Part 2
programme.desc: Marik uses Ra's effect to destroy Slifer and revives it once again to attack Yugi. Yugi plays the card Kaiba gave him, Fiend's Sanctuary, to stop Marik's attack. He then uses Multiply in order to summon Obelisk the Tormentor and devastate Marik.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E43 The Final Face Off — Part 3
programme.desc: Marik's good half possesses Tea again and begs Yugi to destroy him along with his evil side,but he eventually weakens and begins fading away as his dark half loses life points. Yugi and the Pharaoh become hesitant to duel, not wanting to harm the good Marik. As he fades away, Marik appears to an unconscious Odion, thanks him for taking care of him and apologizes, wishing that he could take back his cruel actions. In a cliffhanger, Odion is revealed to have been awakened by Marik's apology.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E44 The Final Face Off — Part 4
programme.desc: Yugi continues fending off Marik's attacks, holding out until he has the cards he needs to defeat Marik. Finally, he summons Dark Magician and Dark Magician Girl and uses them to activate Ragnarok – a spell card with the ability to destroy all the monsters on Marik's field, including The Winged Dragon of Ra that he fused himself with. (The card actually negates and removes all cards Marik controls, at the cost of banishing all monsters to the graveyard that Yami Yugi has.) But Yami Marik claims that if Ra is destroyed (which will leave the good Marik with only 1 life point), then the good Marik will be too weak to resist the power of the Shadow Realm, and will consequently lose his soul....

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E45 The Final Face Off — Part 5
programme.desc: Odion tries to get the good Marik to resist his evil half. As a result, Yami Marik becomes angered, and attacks Odion with the Millennium Rod, which weakens Odion even more. Odion doesn't give up, despite Ishizu's protests. As Marik continues his onslaught (which begins to injure Odion), Odion tells Marik's good side that together, they had conquered his evil half before, and that they could do it again. Then, he tells the good Marik that since Yami Marik was created by the good Marik's hatred, he has the power to destroy him. As Yami Marik raises the Rod to deliver the final blow, the good Marik disappears from the field, and begins fighting against Yami Marik, who struggles for control...

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E46 One for the Road
programme.desc: Yugi and the gang escape from the island in time, but they are forced to leave Kaiba and Mokuba behind. The brothers get away just as the island explodes using the Blue-Eyes White Jet. Yugi's group heads back to Domino City, where they say their farewells and go their separate ways.

programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Maurice’s dream of becoming a techie is cut short due to his domineering father’s insistence on him becoming a priest. Tragedy strikes just as he is about to be ordained and he is called home due to the death of his older brother. Upon his arrival, Maurice discovers his father no longer wants him to be a priest, instead asks Maurice to get married and have a child. A tug-of-war begins between Maurice and his father over his life, but who will win this time?

programme.title: For Richer
programme.desc: Leye and Hadiza Adeyemi have fallen out of love with each other and find themselves heading for a divorce. They are both very happy with this decision until Leye’s parents come to stay for the weekend and things gets very awkward.

programme.title: All Shades Of Amanda
programme.desc: Love finds a young girl who dwells in the captivity of her past heartbreak but she tries to fight it.

programme.title: Broadway to Cheyenne
programme.desc: A gang of big-city thugs trying to set up a protection racket out west meet their match in this B-Western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Rex Bell, billed on the old print ads as The heroic idol of young America! stars as Breezy Kildare, a New York detective who happens to be in Wyoming. When Breezy leads a group of cattleman against the well-armed city boys, the bad guys will wish theyd stayed in New York! The rest of the cast includes such favorites from the period as George Gabby Hayes, Roy DArcy, and Marceline Day. (Day worked opposite everyone from John Wayne to Buster Keaton, but retired from acting shortly after this movie at age 25.) Directed by Harry L. Fraser.

programme.title: The Dude Ranger
programme.desc: Its nothing but action and thrills when an Easterner inherits a cattle ranch and discovers that thousands of cattle have been stolen. Secretly, he signs on as a hired hand at his own ranch to uncover the thief. Once he realizes whats going on, the city boy becomes a hard-riding, avenging son of a six- shooter! Directed by Edward F. Cline from a story by Zane Grey, the film stars George OBrien, Irene Hervey, and LeRoy Mason.

programme.title: Young Buffalo Bill
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars in this highly fictionalized account of Bill Cody's life from director Joseph Kane (Dakota, Flame of Barbary Coast). What it lacks in accuracy is made up for with adventure, as well as and some of Roy's great cowboy songs, including 'Blow Breeze Blow', and 'Rollin' Down to Santa Fe'. Other stars include George 'Gabby' Hayes, Chief Thundercloud, and the lovely Pauline Moore (Young Mr. Lincoln, Charlie Chan at Treasure Island)

programme.title: Down Texas Way
programme.desc: The sixth film in Monogram's Rough Rider series once again follows Buck Roberts (Buck Jones), Tom McCoy (Tim McCall), and Sandy Hopkins (Raymond Hatton) as undercover US Marshals posing as outlaws in order to confound their enemies. When Sandy is framed for murder by a gang of frontier racketeers who hope to take over a small town as their headquarters, Buck and Tom must work separately to save their buddy from a lynch mob and foil the crook's dastardly schemes.

programme.title: My Pal Trigger
programme.desc: Roy Rogers goes to jail after hes wrongly accused of killing Gabby Hayes horse in this action packed yarn from Republic Pictures. All of the old jokes about cowboys kissing their horse may have started with this very movie, as it focuses on Roys loving relationship with Trigger, the greatest horse in all of Hollywood. The film also features Roys beloved Dale Evans, plus, adding some country swing to the musical numbers is Roys favorite backing band, the Sons of the Pioneers! Songs include Ole Faithful, Long, Long Ago and Livin Western Style.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Song of Arizona
programme.desc: This Roy Rogers adventure finds Gabby Whitaker (Gabby Hayes) running a ranch for wayward boys. One of the boys uses stolen money to help Gabby pay off his debts, but things unravel when the boys father, a notorious outlaw named King Blaine, is murdered; the rest of the Blaine gang show up at Gabbys looking for the loot! Director Frank McDonald works with a fine cast, including Dale Evans, Lyle Talbot, and of course, Roys beloved horse Trigger.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: During the French and Indian War, Alice and Cora Munro are joined by Magua in the search for their father, a British officer. Little do they know, their father is being held captive by the Huron warriors, and Magua intends to betray them. Uncas, the last surviving warrior of the Mohican tribe and Hawkeye set out to rescue the hostages and the sisters before it's too late.

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trailblazer
programme.desc: Daniel Boone (Bruce Bennett) battles Shawnee warriors as he leads a band of settlers into Kentucky in this frontier potboiler from Albert C. Gannaway Productions. Made at the height of Hollywood's fascination with pioneer days, the film also stars Lon Chaney Jr. as Chief Blackfish, and country singer Faron Young as a handsome young suitor for Boone's daughter. There's plenty of action and danger here as the Shawnee are convinced that Boone is trying to steal their land. But Boone is ready, not even fearing death by tomahawk. It isn't how you die, Boone says. It's what you live for.

programme.title: The Kansan
programme.desc: Richard Dix stars in this epic of the boisterous and brawling Old West! Wounded in a gun battle with the notorious James gang, John Bonniwell (Dix) wakes up in the hospital to find out hes been elected marshal! He quickly learns that this hot-headed frontier town can only be cooled off with blazing lead and dynamite! Jane Wyatt, Albert Dekker, Victor Jory, and Robert Armstrong also star in this tale of smashing fists and crashing bullets from director George Archainbaud (The Lost Squadron).

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: He Dared Death In The Outlaw's Lair! John Travers (John Wayne) takes on a mysterious gang leader known as The Shadow in this vintage western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Director/writer Robert N. Bradbury (Blue Steel, Riders of Destiny) gets the best of a remarkable cast that includes George Gabby Hayes. Of interest to film buffs is that the feature was shot in various California locations by Oscar winning cinematographer Archie Stout (The Quiet Man).

programme.title: Riders of Destiny
programme.desc: John Wayne sings! Well, not really. His voice was dubbed here, but as Singin Sandy Saunders hes still able to write the code of justice with a blazing sixgun! Hes a government agent out to help a group of ranchers in their battle with a villain who is tying up local water rights. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Al St. John, Yakima Canutt, and Cecilia Parker, Riders of Destiny was filmed early in Waynes career it was his first for Lone Star but the unmistakable swagger is already in place!

programme.title: Man from Utah
programme.desc: WHIRLING ROPES AND SNARLING GUNS IN THE GALLOPING GRIP OF A GLAMOROUS DRAMA! John Wayne stars as John Weston, a man hired to investigate shady doings at a local rodeo. It seems all the riders who are on the verge of winning end up dead. Along with Wayne, this tale of action on the range also stars the usual Lone Star Picture stock company, including Gabby Hayes and Yakima Canutt!

programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Billy the Kid, Pat Garrett, and Doc Holliday ride again in Howard Hughes' epic 1943 western, but the character you'll remember most is sultry country vixen Rio McDonald. Hughes' nationwide search for an actress to play Rio resulted in the film debut of Jane Russell, whose natural assets were allegedly helped by a special bra designed by Hughes. When The Outlaw finally received a nationwide release in 1946, its success vindicated Hughes and made Russell a star. As for Hughes' infamous bra, Russell said in her 1988 memoir, I never wore it, and he never knew.

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: An unholy alliance! Marking the feature film debut of one of Hollywoods most influential and widely referenced auteur directors, Sam Peckinpah, The Deadly Companions centers on a redemptive journey to escort a funeral procession through dangerous Indian Territory. Featuring fine work from a top-notch cast that includes the inimitable Maureen OHara at the height of her illustrious career, Peckinpahs first foray into film provides a promising glance into the energetic and violent nature of his iconic later works.

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: A cavalry officer sympathetic to the wronged Sioux tribe fixes a meeting between Chief Sitting Bull and President Grant but a dishonest Indian Agent and a hateful General Custer test the Sioux's patience, threatening to derail the peace-talks. Directed and co-written by Sidney Salkow; starring Dale Robertson, Mary Murphy, J. Carrol Naish. Also, look for legendary character actor Iron Eyes Cody as Crazy Horse.

programme.title: The Red Rope
programme.desc: Hired killers and Old West outlaws stand front and center in this riveting tale from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Bob Steele, one of the busiest stars in movie history (everything from the silent era to Republic Pictures to working with Clint Eastwood in Hang Em High) is here as Tom Shaw, the target of a bad mans desperation and hate. Steele appeared in more than 240 movies and television shows, but was never more impressive than in The Red Rope!

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: What happens when Abraham Lincoln himself comes to New Mexico to discuss a treaty with Native American chief Acoma (Ted de Corsia)? Can the hotbed of emotions be quieted by cavalry Captain Hunt (Lew Ayres)? Or will the Captains superiors insist on provoking with the native tribe? Find out what happens in this fictional tale packed with action from 1951!

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: The entire gang is here! Roy Rogers, Dale Evans, Gabby Hayes, and Trigger are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner. Songs include I Wish I Was A Kid Again and Cowboy Ham and Eggs.

programme.title: Heart of the Golden West
programme.desc: Roy Rogers, Gabby Hayes, and Smiley Burnette team up to protect the ranchers of Cherokee City from the false charges of illegal cattle trafficking. It may seem like the odds are against Roy, but just watch as he changes the course of the law with his flaming bullets, and, of course, a few songs. For trivia buffs: Smiley Burnette joined Roy because Gene Autry, the actor for whom he usually served as a sidekick, had joined the service!

programme.title: Wildfire: The Story of a Horse
programme.desc: Fanning (John Miljan) has his men rustle horses and then blame it on a wild horse named Wildfire. Happy and Alkali arrive and immediately get into trouble with Fanning and his men. When Alkali is shot, Happy catches the outlaws but the Judge not only releases them, he discharges the Sheriff and tries to arrest Happy for rustling! Starring Bob Steele and Sterling Holloway, directed by Robert Emmett Tansey. 1945 (Color).

programme.title: Shine on Harvest Moon
programme.desc: Jackson and his gang are cattle rustlers holed up in Jackson Hole Wyoming. Roy's partner Brower was once Jackson's partner and is now suspected of being in cahoots with him. Someone is tipping off Jackson as to the cattle's whereabouts and when Roy learns who it is he has a plan to trap Jackson and clear his partner. Starring Roy Rogers, Lynne Roberts, and Myrtle Wiseman as 'Lulu Belle. Directed by Joseph Kane.

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: After a condemned gunfighter (Steve Forrest) survives his own hanging, he helps a young widow stop a pitiless land baron from taking her ranch. This television feature boasts a strong cast of recognizable characters, including Will Geer, Sharon Acker, Dean Jagger, BarBara Luna, and Cameron Mitchell. Director Michael Caffey would go on to work on such hit shows as Barnaby Jones and MacGyver. Also, look for John Mitchum, younger brother of Robert, in a small role. This movie originally aired on ABC-TV and was considered the pilot for a possible series. Writer/producer Andrew Fenady was behind several opular TV shows such as Branded and The Rebel, as well as the 1970 John Wayne feature, Chisum.

programme.title: Kentucky Rifle
programme.desc: His Wits, Weapons and Women, Turned Defeat Into Victory! A man brings a wagonload of Kentucky rifles through Indian Territory. Unfortunately the Indians realize what he has and offer the travelers an ultimatum: the rifles or their lives! Starring Lance Fuller, Sterling Holloway, Henry Hull, Chill Wills, Cathy Downs, and Jeanne Cagney, plus one of the great B-Western heels, I. Stanford Jolley!

programme.title: Captain Apache (Edited Version)
programme.desc: After Harry T. Collier, a beloved commissioner of Indian Affairs, is murdered in late March during the1880s, Captain Apache, an Indian graduate of West Point, is assigned by the army to investigate the crime. Suspecting that O.J., the sheriff of a town bordering the reservation may be involved in the killing, Apache travels there and finds the sheriff dining with his mistress Maude at the Paradise Saloon. Before Apache can question him, however, O.J. abruptly departs and rides out of town with Apache in pursuit. When Apache apprehends him, O.J. swears that he did not kill Collier and relates that the agents dying words were April Morning. Meanwhile, Griffin, a wealthy landowner and six of...

programme.title: Cowboy And The Prizefighter
programme.desc: Red Ryder takes Steve Stevenson, who has saved his life, to his ranch and gives him a job. Red's aunt, the Duchess, knew Steve's father, who supposedly committed suicide after losing his ranch betting on a prizefight. Steve refuses to believe that his father took his own life, suspecting he was murdered. Red and Little Beaver aid Steve in finding his father killer.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: The Dawn Rider
programme.desc: John Wayne was still a few years from major stardom when he appeared as John Mason, a man seeking revenge for his fathers murder. Marion Burns stars as Alice, Masons love interest, while Reed Howes stars as Masons friend and rival for Alices affection. When Mason finally tracks down the man responsible for his fathers death, will Ben help, or stand in his way? Produced by Lone Star Pictures, the group behind many of Waynes early films, The Dawn Rider is a stirring yarn about the price of vengeance.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: John Wayne plays a man wrongly convicted of murder in this exciting western drama from Lone Star Pictures. You'll enjoy plenty of gun action and thundering hoofbeats as he escapes from jail and then joins a gang, hoping to find the real killer! Director Armand Schaefer (The Miracle Rider, The Lost Jungle) whips up some fine performances from a cast of B-movie favorites, including Lane Chandler (Samson and Delilah) and the great stunt rider, Yakima Canutt. And of course, the film features plenty of fight scenes, made memorable by John Wayne's big swinging' right fist! For film buffs: This was one of 11 films Wayne starred in that year, making 1933 one of the busiest years of Wayne's...

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Undercover US Marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is investigating a rash of robberies by a character known as The Polka Dot Bandit in this B-movie gem. Along the way, Carruthers finds himself in more trouble than he'd ever expected! Written and directed by Robert N. Bradbury, the film features George Gabby Hayes, Eleanor Hunt, and many other favorites of the era. Wayne was only 27 at the time of Blue Steel, but was well on his way to becoming The Duke.

programme.title: Santa Fe Trail
programme.desc: Oscar winner Michael Curtiz (Casablanca, Mildred Pierce) directed this exciting drama about Army officer Jeb Stuart and the days leading up to the Civil War. Errol Flynn (The Adventures of Robin Hood) stars as Stuart, with Olivia de Havilland as his romantic interest (the seventh of nine times they were paired together by Warner Bros.) The cast includes Ronald Reagan as General George Custer, and Raymond Massey as John Brown, with such familiar faces as Alan Hale and Van Hefflin in supporting roles. Filmed partly in Santa Fe!

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: Randolph Scott plays James Barlow, an agent from Chicago hired to bring the notorious Reno brothers to justice. But wouldnt you know it? The Reno gang includes a beautiful young woman (Mala Powers), who catches Barlows eye. This western from director Tim Whelan (The Thief of Bagdad) features cinematography by two-time Oscar winner Ray Rennahan (Gone With The Wind), while the screenplay was by noted author Horace McCoy (They Shoot Horses, Dont They?). Theres also an all-star cast, including Forrest Tucker, J. Carrol Naish, Edgar Buchanan, Denver Pyle, and several other shaggy sidewinders!

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cyclone Tom Saunders starts a ruckus in a Chinese laundry and has to go before a judge. Unable to pay his fine, he is bailed out by a local cattle rancher and agrees to do 30 days' work for him. It's not too long before he becomes enmeshed in a war between rustlers and outlaws.

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: Bulldog Courage
programme.desc: Tim McCoy, one of the unsung heroes of 1930s western pictures, stars in a dual role. First, hes Slim Braddock, a miner who turns to robbing stagecoaches after being swindled by a banker. When Slim is murdered, his son Tim, also played by McCoy, seeks vengeance. Directed by B-movie legend Sam Newfield for Excelsior Pictures, this film is a showcase for McCoy, who appeared in more than 90 movies and in 1960 earned a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame!

programme.title: The Gunman from Bodie
programme.desc: The Rough Riders, a popular group that thrilled audiences in the early 1940s, are after a gang of rustlers in this B-western from Hollywood's Poverty Row. Starring Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, and Raymond Hatton, this movie features everything from lawmen going undercover to the Rough Riders looking after an orphaned baby! Also, be on the lookout for the beautiful Christine McIntyre, who would go on to appear in several of the Three Stooges shorts for Colombia Pictures.

programme.title: Arizona Bound
programme.desc: The Rough Riders are called upon to help save a stagecoach line. From 1941, starring Buck Jones and Tim McCoy, plus Horace Murphy and Luana Walters. Directed by Spencer Bennett.

programme.title: Texas Brooklyn and Heaven
programme.desc: When Eddie Tayloe (Guy Madison, 5 Against the House) receives $6,000 from his grandfather, he decides to leave his drab newspaper job and move to New York. His dream is to have a play produced on Broadway. Along the way he picks up a pretty hitchhiker (Diana Lynn, The Miracle of Morgan's Creek) who is also leaving her own dreary life for a shot at New York. Unfortunately, they find that the Big Apple is a hard place to make a living. But it's also a city where circumstances keep bringing them together!

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: Sunset Carson Rides Again
programme.desc: Sunset Carson is trying to raise money for a new school and his partner Sam Webster is out to stop him. When Carson plans a benefit prize-fight, Webster plans to make off with the proceeds. Direted by Oliver Drake; starring Sunset Carson, Al Terry, Pat Starling, Ron Ormond, Joe Hiser.

programme.title: Wagon Wheels
programme.desc: Randolph Scott (Ride the High Country) stars as Clint Belmet, the leader of a wagon train on the way to Oregon. Along the route he and his crew deal with various hardships, including Indian attacks and a fellow named Murdock (Monte Blue) who is out to stop them at any cost. With a cast that includes the likes of Gail Patrick and Billy Lee, this adventure saga was based on a novel by the western master, Zane Grey (Riders of the Purple Sage, Fighting Caravans). Trivia note: The film's original title was Caravans West.

programme.title: The Gay Cavalier
programme.desc: The Cisco Kid, along with Pancho, try to help an unhappy bride.

programme.title: Under Western Stars
programme.desc: Roy Rogers debuts in his starring role as the likable cowboy sent to Congress with a mission: let Washington know about the suffering of farmers in the wake of America's 1930s Dustbowl. Enjoy the singing cowboy in his first starring role, rubbing shoulder with politians, going up against greedy executives, and representing a whole people group you'll see why Rogers became a national icon! Frog Millhouse: Smiley Burnett. Elanore Fairbanks: Carol Hughes. John Fairbanks: Guy Usher. Plus music and singing from the Maple City Four. (The song Dust was nominated for an Academy Award!) Directed by Joe Kane.

programme.title: Cattle Queen of Montana
programme.desc: Sierra Nevada Jones, a feisty young woman, attempts to stake her claim in the cattle business despite threats from greedy land grabbers and their hired killers.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this vintage western. He and George Gabby Hayes strike it rich with a gold mine, only to find their lives complicated by women and crooked officials. Things get even messier when the good guys are framed for murder! Its all action here, particularly since legendary stuntman Yakima Cannut stars as one of the films heavies. Who will win the fight over the gold and the girl? Directed by Robert N. Bradbury for Monogram Pictures. Also starring Barbara Sheldon. (The film was also known as Gold Strike River.)

programme.title: Lawless Frontier
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this vintage western about a man avenging the murder of his parents. Other cast members include frequent Wayne sidekick George 'Gabby Hayes', plus Yakima Canutt, Sheila Terry, and Jack Rockwell. This Paul Malvern Production from director Robert N. Bradbury also features Earl Dwire, one of the great B-movie villains, as Zanti, the ruthless bandit who sets the action in motion.

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: He likes his whiskey hard... His women soft... And his west all to himself! Inspired by Shakespeares The Taming of the Shrew (1594), John Wayne (The Searchers, Stagecoach), Maureen OHara (Miracle on 34th Street, The Parent Trap), and Patrick Wayne (The Searchers, The Alamo) star in this western comedy directed by Andrew V. McLaglen (Gunsmoke, The Wild Geese). George Washington McLintock (John Wayne) is the wealthiest man in his territory who utilizes his power and influence to maintain order between farmers, ranchers, Indians, corrupt government officials, and his own family! McLintock is McNificent!

programme.title: The Music in Me
programme.desc: A singer/songwriter leaves her dreams behind to help her family, until one special guy and a group of musically-challenged strangers help her find her voice again.

programme.title: The Love Club: Sydney
programme.desc: When Sydney reconnects with her ex and joins a Half Marathon he is running, she asks the Love Club to help.

programme.title: Love's Second Chance
programme.desc: Stylist Rose inherits her grandmother's dress shop and reconnects with her old crush, Cole, sparking romance.

programme.title: Love & Where to Find It
programme.desc: Two local coffee shop owners despise each other but begin to fall in love while sending each other messages on their friends' behalf.

programme.title: Offline
programme.desc: An online stalker torments a young woman.

programme.title: Stolen Dreams
programme.desc: Laura Paddington is overcome with joy when her daughter, Zoe, returns to her after being abducted 17 years before--but is Zoe really her long lost child?

programme.title: My Daddy is in Heaven
programme.desc: Becky, Adam and their 5-year-old daughter Acie are a perfect family until a tragic accident during a 4th of July celebration kills their father. Struggling with grief, Becky decides she needs to leave the family farm and all its memories. She leaves Acie with her grandfather Ben and visits with her friend from school, June. With all the best intent, June offers Becky plenty of distraction from her family life. Fueled by her anger at G*d and loss of faith, Becky starts drinking and making other self-destructive choices. Then, after Becky is arrested, Ben threatens to keep Acie until Becky is back on track. A chance encounter in a bus station with a traveler gives Becky what she needs to...

programme.title: The Joneses Unplugged
programme.desc: With their relationship under strain, a young couple decides to ditch the distractions of technology in order to reconnect to one another.

programme.title: Watching Over You
programme.desc: A security guard's unhealthy obsession with a single mom and her daughter escalates into something terrifying.

programme.title: The wrong Nanny
programme.desc: When Blake finds her birth mother and her now-perfect family, Blake will do anything it takes to destroy it.

programme.title: Blood Ties
programme.sub-title: S02 : E05 Episode 17 - The Devil You Know
programme.desc: Henry’s old flame, Christina, is back and in need of his help. Vicki wonders if she has ulterior motives.

programme.title: A Lethal Lesson
programme.desc: High school teacher Lauren is accused of an affair by a student, putting her job and life in jeopardy.

programme.title: Offline
programme.desc: An online stalker torments a young woman.

programme.title: Stolen Dreams
programme.desc: Laura Paddington is overcome with joy when her daughter, Zoe, returns to her after being abducted 17 years before--but is Zoe really her long lost child?

Then, after Becky is arrested, Ben threatens to keep Acie until Becky is back on track. A chance encounter in a bus station with a traveler gives Becky what she needs to...

programme.desc: A security guard's unhealthy obsession with a single mom and her daughter escalates into something terrifying.

programme.title: The wrong Nanny
programme.desc: When Blake finds her birth mother and her now-perfect family, Blake will do anything it takes to destroy it.

programme.title: The Perfect Soulmate
programme.desc: A poet with an abusive husband reaches out to a fan for help, only to find an even more dangerous companion.

programme.title: WWJD II The Woodcarver
programme.desc: A troubled youth vandalizes a church and winds up in a close association with the woodcarver whose work he destroyed.

programme.title: The Past Never Dies
programme.desc: CASEY MARSH was born in captivity. Her mother, JANE, was abducted as a teenager and gave birth to Casey while she was being held by the kidnapper, TIMOTHY FAST. Jane eventually escaped when Casey was 6 years old. Timothy Fast was arrested and incarcerated. Ever since, Jane has struggled to regain a normal life for her and her daughter. For Casey, the memories of a childhood in captivity still haunt her. Jane, on the other hand, has seemingly moved on. She has re-married and is happy. When a number of local women start to go missing, Jane reveals to Casey that Timothy might have had an accomplice and wonders if he is involved. The kidnapping M.O. is eerily similar. Casey is furious that...

programme.title: Pure Country 2: The Gift
programme.desc: Three angels bestow the gift of song to a young girl, who must follow a series of rules in order hold on to it during her rise to fame and fortune.

programme.title: The Song to My Heart
programme.desc: An organic tea shop owner helps a music sensation write lyrics for a new solo album.

programme.title: All for Love
programme.desc: After 73 errors about firefighters in her last romance novel, Jo's publisher, Diana, insists on weeks of research for her next book by training at a military boot camp run by her navy seal brother.

programme.title: At Home With Tori
programme.desc: Tori is hosting a 90210 themed party and wants to create some classic Beverly Hills appys.

programme.title: The Perfect Soulmate
programme.desc: A poet with an abusive husband reaches out to a fan for help, only to find an even more dangerous companion.

programme.title: WWJD II The Woodcarver
programme.desc: A troubled youth vandalizes a church and winds up in a close association with the woodcarver whose work he destroyed.

programme.title: The Past Never Dies
programme.desc: CASEY MARSH was born in captivity. Her mother, JANE, was abducted as a teenager and gave birth to Casey while she was being held by the kidnapper, TIMOTHY FAST. programme.title: De flyvende djævle
programme.desc: Anders Refns prisbelønnede hovedværk om trapezgruppen ’De flyvende djævle’, som består af en far der bestemmer det hele, hans søn og datter og datterens forlovede.

programme.title: Auggie
programme.desc: Følelsen af ensomhed fører førtidspensionisten Felix længere ind i en virtuel virkelighed og længere bort fra virkeligheden og hans familie.

programme.title: Officer og spion
programme.desc: I 1895 anklages kaptajn Alfred Dreyfus (Louis Garrel), en ung og lovende officer, for spionage til tyskerne og dømmes til livsvarigt fængsel på Djævleøen. Dreyfus' ydmygelse følges også af Georges Picquart (Jean Dujardin), der er blevet forfremmet til at lede kontraespionagenheden.

programme.title: Sommersby
programme.desc: Efter seks år som soldat i Den Amerikanske Borgerkrig vender en venligere og mere betænksom soldat hjem til sin gård og kone, som ellers troede, han var død. En skuffet bejler afslører, at manden er en bedrager, og at den rigtige Sommersby er efterlyst for mord.

programme.title: Miss Potter
programme.desc: Beatrix Potter er en 30-årig singlekvinde i en tid, hvor kvindens fineste opgave er at gifte sig opad og aldrig se nedad. Ingen, og da slet ikke Beatrix' familie, kan forstå, at hun hellere vil tegne og fortælle små historier om dyr.

programme.title: The Forgiven
programme.desc: Efter apartheidens afslutning mødes ærkebiskop Desmond Tutu med en brutal morder, der søger forløsning.

programme.title: Enter the Void
programme.desc: Instruktøren af 2000-tallets største film er tilbage med et værk, som ikke ligner noget andet: en følelsesmæssigt forstyrrende og visuelt overvældende mareridtsrejse gennem liv, død og genfødsel.

programme.title: Undine
programme.desc: Christian Petzold er tilbage med en moderniseret version af den gamle kærlighedsfabel om vandvæsenet Undine, der først kan blive menneske, når hun forelsker sig i en mand, men som må dræbe ham og vende tilbage til sit element, vandet, hvis han ikke er hende tro.

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart

programme.title: Bekas
programme.desc: Det er de tidlige 90’ere og Saddam Husseins regime har lagt et stort pres på den kurdiske del af Irak. To hjemløse kurdiske drenge ser Superman i byens første biograf og beslutter sig for at tage til Amerika. For at komme dertil har de har brug for pas, penge og en masse held.

programme.title: The Last Bus
programme.desc: Da en ældre mands hustru går bort, rejser han gennem Skotland og England med bus for at opfylde sit løfte om at sprede hendes aske tæt på deres første fælles hjem.

programme.title: Palo Alto
programme.desc: High School-eleverne Teddy, April, Fred og Emily er ligesom alle andre på jagt efter noget at lave i Palo Altos kedelige forstadsmiljø.

programme.title: Rules Don't Apply
programme.desc: Rules Don't Apply, der er instrueret af Beatty og baseret på en historie af Beatty og Bo Goldman, er fuldt stjernebesat med bl.a. Annette Bening og Matthew Broderick.

programme.title: Brain On Fire
programme.desc: SUSANNAH CAHALAN er en ung kvinde, som lige er blevet færdig med sin universitetsuddannelse og nu udlever sine drømme i New York City. Hun er en spirende journalist på New York Post, og hun forelsker sig i musikeren STEPHEN.

programme.title: Tigerland
programme.desc: En gruppe rekrutter gennemgår avanceret infanteritræning i Fort Polk, Louisiana, det berygtede Tigerland, det sidste stop inden de bliver sendt til Vietnam.

programme.desc: Året er 1975 og Angola hærges af borgerkrig. Militære faktioner strides om kontrollen af den nyligt uafhængige koloni. Den polske journalist Ryszard Kapuscinski ankommer for at dække konflikten.

programme.title: Venus I Pels
programme.desc: Kan en kvindes list overvinde en mands storhedsvanvid? På et parisisk teater er den tilsyneladende talentløse amatørskuespiller Vanda til audition. Hun vil gøre hvad som helst for rollen, men da hun endelig får chancen, sker der en uforklarlig forandring.

programme.title: To The Wonder
programme.desc: Efter at have tabt sit hjerte i Frankrig, vender den unge forfatter Neil hjem til sin hjemby i Oklahoma med sin nye udkårne. Men efterhånden som middelhavsromancen falmer, splittes Neil mellem sin europæiskekærlighed og en lokal flamme fra fortiden.

programme.title: De flyvende djævle

programme.desc: Den aldrende litteraturprofessor David lever alene og har en forkærlighed for unge studerende. En dag møder han den smukke Consuela og forfører hende uden seriøse hensigter. Efterhånden uddybes deres forhold, og den gamle kyniker opdager pludselig, at han er forelsket.

programme.desc: Mens en velhavende ung mand bliver opereret; oplever han intraoperativ opmærksomhed og opdager; at det kirurgiske team havde til hensigt at myrde ham.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Da en hårdtarbejdende redaktør på The New Yorker (Helen Hunt) følger efter sin søn (Brenton Thwaites) til L.A., efter han er droppet ud af college for at finde sig selv, ender hun med selv at være den, der kastes ud i en fuldstændig forvandling.

programme.title: Alvin og de frække jordegern 3
programme.desc: De frække jordegern og ”The Chipettes” er på ferie og forvandler et luksus-krydstogtskib til deres egen legeplads, inden de strander på en øde ø.

programme.title: Vampires Suck
programme.desc: En vampyrparodi med masser af blodige jokes!Becca, en ængstelig teenager, som ligeer begyndt på en nye skole, føler sigsplittet mellem sine følelser for deto overnaturlige bejlere: en lunefuldvampyr og en ægte behåret varulv.

programme.title: Epic Movie
programme.desc: Historien handler om fire ikke-så-unge forældreløse børn: den første opdraget af en museumsinspektør på Louvre (hvor en albino snigmorder lurer), den anden, en flygtet fra mexicansk fribrydning, den tredje, et offer for slanger på sit fly, og den fjerne, en “normal” borger i mutant X-samfundet.

programme.title: Pushing Tin
programme.desc: Nick Falzone er flyveleder nummer et, indtil en stilfærdig fremmed, Russell Bell, bliver overført til afdelingen. Rivaliseringen mellem de to øverste flyveledere i New York TRACON eskalerer til et potentielt farligt niveau.

programme.title: Three Day Millionaire
programme.desc: En hårdtslående komedie om en flok unge fiskere fra den regnvåde nordengelske havn, Grimsby, som skal udføre deres livs kup for at redde byen. Glem Oceans’ 11 og forbered jer på Grimsbys 4.

programme.title: Man sku' være noget ved musikken
programme.desc: Handlingen i denne komedie udspiller sig i og omkring værtshuset Café Strudsen på Nørrebro i København med tjeneren Søren (Karl Stegger), servitricen Caja, pianisten Lasse (Otto Brandenburg) og en række stamgæster som hovedpersoner,.

Efter et sammenstød med to lejemordere, mens hun er i gang med at se et afsnit, får Betty vrangforestillinger og forvandles til "sygeplejerske Betty'', og hun begiver sig ud på en mission for at finde sin eneste ene.

programme.desc: En ensom enke har planlagt at rejse jorden rundt med sin mands aske for at besøge de steder, de faldt for i de forskellige film, de så sammen. Det første stop på rejsen forandrer hendes liv for altid.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Den flittige highschool-pige, Vee Delmonico, har fået nok af bare at være tilskuer til livet.

programme.desc: Et science fiction-mysterium om en dysfunktionel familie som bor på en ranch i Texas og trues af en skabning i skoven. For at kunne overleve truslen, bliver de samtidig nødt til at løse sine egne indre konflikter.

programme.title: Taxi 4
programme.desc: Ulykkesfuglen Émilien fra kriminalpolitiet i Marseille har en af Europas mest eftersøgte mænd i sin varetægt.

programme.title: American Exit
programme.desc: Charlie Bond står ved en skillevej i livet. Han er lige blevet separeret fra sin kone og bliver nu bedt om at passe deres søn Leo i en weekend. Det er dårlig timing, for han er netop i færd med at planlægge et kunstkup for at skaffe nogle hurtige penge.

programme.title: TMNT
programme.desc: Splint; rotten sensei; fornemmer, at hans fire teenagere skildpadde-disciple er vokset fra hinanden og har brug for at knytte bånd for at besejre et gammelt monster.

programme.title: Tracers

programme.title: 13Th District
programme.desc: Paris, 2013. Hardcore ghettokriminalitet har fået regeringen til at isolere de belastede områder bag høje sikkerhedsmure...

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Den unge israeler Yossi Ghinsberg forlader en tryg fremtid for at jage en umulig drøm dybt inde i Amazonas' regnskov.

programme.desc: Efter at have tydet en besked, som er blevet fundet i en satellit, opdager den geniale kryptograf Alex, at han bliver forfulgt af regeringsmagtens agenter og overnaturlige ting begynder at ske.

programme.desc: Lejemoderen Frank har lagt sit tidligere arbejde på hylden og forsøger at leve et tilsyneladende almindeligt liv sammen med sin veninde og sin datter. En dag kommer en berygtet mafiaboss forbi for at få Franks hjælp til at få dræbt den, der har taget livet af hans lille datter.

programme.title: Legal Action
programme.desc: Den talentfulde advokat Casey McKay føres til en lille by af sin ekskone for at forsvare hendes bror, som er under anklage for at have myrdet en offentlig anklager. Her opdager McKay en sammensværgelse, som bringer ham i åben konflikt med byens mest korrupte bygherre, mr. Gates.

programme.title: Delta Farce
programme.desc: En trio tumpede venner forveksles med soldater og sendes til Irak. Men efter at blive smidt ud på vejen ender de i en forladt ørkenby, der desperat har brug for hjælp. Kan de spille helterollen for alvor?

programme.title: Texas Red
programme.desc: Den sande historie om den legendariske Texas Red, en afroamerikansk mand, der blev jaget brutalt langs præriens barske landskab af hundredvis af lovløse cowboys gennem Mississippis vinterørken. Alt sammen for at gribe den mest eftertragtede belønning.

programme.title: Buddy gi'r en håndfuld øretæver
programme.desc: Trinity-seriestjernen Bud Spencer vender tilbage til det vilde vesten i komedien om fupmageren, Buddy, der forveksles med en læge, efter at hans ven, Cocoa utilsigtet stjæler en kuffert med kirurgiske instrumenter.

programme.title: American Exit
programme.desc: Charlie Bond står ved en skillevej i livet. Han er lige blevet separeret fra sin kone og bliver nu bedt om at passe deres søn Leo i en weekend. Det er dårlig timing, for han er netop i færd med at planlægge et kunstkup for at skaffe nogle hurtige penge.

programme.title: Cold Zone
programme.desc: En storm er på vej. Ingen kan forudsige det. Ingen kan måle dens størrelse. Nu bliver en familie nødt til at overleve den. Og ingen kan søge ly fra stormen, ingen kommer ind fra kulden.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Den unge israeler Yossi Ghinsberg forlader en tryg fremtid for at jage en umulig drøm dybt inde i Amazonas' regnskov.

programme.title: Street Fighter: The Legend Of Chun-Li
programme.desc: Efter kidnapningen af hendes far begiver Chun-Li sig ned i Hong Kongs brutale underverden - hungrende efter hævn og på vej mod den ultimative konfrontation med den største fjende, hun nogensinde vil komme op imod.

programme.title: District 13 - Ultimatum
programme.desc: Tårnhøje mure omkranser Paris' ultra-kriminelle ghettoer, hvor fem forskellige bander hersker - nu med mere magt end nogensinde.

programme.title: Game Of Death
programme.desc: Når selv CIA giver op, ringer de til "Agent Marcus" - en nådesløs hitman med speciale i umulige opgaver.

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart
programme.desc: Vi er ved at indhente vores skønhedssøvn! Bliv hængende for mere uvurderlig underholdning udvalgt af Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Triassic Hunt
programme.desc: Da to genetisk fremstillede dinosaurer flygter fra laboratoriet, tilkaldes et hold lejesoldater for at fange dem. Men soldaterne indser snart, at dinosaurerne er lige så kloge som mennesker, og så er en vild kattens leg med musen i gang.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Efter næsten at have mistet livet i “Daredevil” er superheltinden ELEKTRA tilbage i en verden af drab og bedrag – stærkere, smukkere og smidigere end før, men hendes ofre når knap at opfatte, hvad der sker. Hendes mission er at dræbe, og hun er effektiv.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Den flittige highschool-pige, Vee Delmonico, har fået nok af bare at være tilskuer til livet.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Banana Joe lever lykkeligt i en tropisk landsby i Sydamerika, der endnu ikke er blevet forpestet af hårdhudede virksomheder, korruption, stoffer, bander eller andre sygdomme fra det moderne samfund.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Bob Ho er en international superagent, der har prøvet det meste... biljagter, eksplosioner, fald fra høje bygninger... you name it. Men intet kan måle sigmed hans næste store opgave: En weekend som babysitter for hans kærestes tre møgunger!

programme.title: The Fourth Musketeer
programme.desc: På sin fars vegne rejser den unge d'Artagnan fra landskabet i Gascogne til Paris, hvor han er involveret i et snedigt og meget kompliceret komplot mellem kongens musketerer og kardinal Richelieus vagter.

programme.title: Også engle spiser bønner
programme.desc: Charlie (Bud Spencer) er fribryder i forbudstidens New York, og han nægter at være med til at fikse en kamp, og gangsterbossen Angelo (Robert Middleton) har satset penge på modstanderen.

programme.title: The Condemned 2
programme.desc: Efter en mislykket mission for at fange lederen af en livsfarlig gamblingring bliver dusørjæger Will Tanner den jagede — et menneskeligt mål i et spil, hvor deltagerne skal dræbe eller bliver dræbt.

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: Cam er cykelbud i New Yorks livsfarlige gader. Han kan klare alt på to hjul, men en gæld til en lokal mafiabande får ham til at tage benene på nakken. Lige indtil han ved en tilfældighed møder den smukke og forførende Nikki.

programme.title: Death At A Funeral
programme.desc: For de fleste er begravelser bare noget, der skal overstås, og hvis det stod til Daniel, så sprang han gerne denne dag over, hvor hans far skal stedes til hvile.

programme.title: The Dresser
programme.desc: På en skæbnesvanger aften under Anden Verdenskrig opfører en gruppe turnerende skuespillere en forestilling af Shakespeares "King Lear" i et lille engelsk egnsteater.

programme.title: Movie 43
programme.desc: Luk øjnene og hold dig for ørerne! Peter Farrelly, som gav os "Vild Med Mary" og "Dum & Dummere", har samlet det vildeste skuespillerhold til en film, der bryder ALLE grænser! Det er muligvis ikke god smag... men det er helt sikkert gode grin!

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: Den alkoholiserede Matti, der bor under broerne, er ved at arve en betydelig sum penge fra sin amerikanske faster. Men manden skal se præsentabel ud under fasterens besøg. Matti fortæller sin ven, der arbejder som bilforhandler, om situationen, og han foreslår en rollebytte mod kompensation.

programme.title: Gensyn med Yorkshire
programme.desc: Arthur Morrison finder ud af, at han har kræft og kun har nogle få uger tilbage at leve i. Hans voksne søn, Blake, rejser til Yorkshire for at bo hos sin mor i den by, han voksede op i. Efterhånden som Arthurs tilstand forværres, ser Blake tilbage på sit forhold til faren.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: Kærlighed overvinder alt ... selv den uimodståelige trang til at spise din kærestes hjernemasse! I en ikke så fjern fremtid er jorden befolket af lige dele menneskeædende zombier og zombiebekæmpende mennesker.

programme.title: Hollywood's hemmelighed
programme.desc: I 1924 samlede mediemogul William Randolph Hearst nogle af verdens mest kendte personligheder til en sejltur på hans yacht, hvilket resulterede i et stadig uløst, neddysset mord.

programme.title: Awake
programme.desc: En mand vågner på hospitalet uden erindring om, hvem han er, og finder ud af, at han er efterlyst for at have begået en række mord.

programme.title: Harsh Times
programme.desc: Jim Davis er vendt hjem fra Irak. Men hans egen krig i L.A.'s ghetto er først ved at begynde...

programme.title: Rules Don't Apply
programme.desc: Rules Don't Apply, der er instrueret af Beatty og baseret på en historie af Beatty og Bo Goldman, er fuldt stjernebesat med bl.a. Annette Bening og Matthew Broderick.

programme.title: Cube
programme.desc: Syv helt fremmede med forskellige personligheder placeres modvilligt i en endeløs labyrint af dødbringende fælder.

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart
programme.desc: Vi er ved at indhente vores skønhedssøvn! Bliv hængende for mere uvurderlig underholdning udvalgt af Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Saints Of War
programme.desc: Jersey, 1942. Da Hitler strammer grebet om Vesteuropa, bliver Kanaløerne besat. Tyskerne brugere Jersey som en base, hvor krigsfanger knokler i arbejdslejre, og indbyggerne står over for en fremtid fuld af usikkerhed og frygt.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Velkommen til en katolsk pigeskole i hjertet af Chicago, byen som er hjem for USA's mest populære danseshow: Dance TV! Udvekslingsstudenten Janey Glenn er et nervevrag, da hun bliver præsenteret for sine fnisende klassekammerater af den strenge søster Katherine.

programme.title: The Girl Next Door
programme.desc: 3-G’eren Matthew (Emile Hirsch) har besluttet sig for at læse som en vanvittig, tage sin eksamen med topkarakterer og i øvrigt undgå alle optræk til teenage ballade.Uheldigvis for ham, holder planen ikke længere end til Ballade med stort ”B” flytter ind i huset ved siden af...

programme.title: De uarvede
programme.desc: "De Værdiløse" er en tidløs beskrivelse af, hvordan den småkriminelle Manne, landsbydrengen Harri og den smukke Veera kører i en Volga gennem de forsvindende finske landskaber, mens politiet og gangstere konstant hænger på deres hæle.

programme.title: The Birdcage
programme.desc: Armand og Albert bygget det perfekte liv for sig selv ved at passe deres natklub i Miami. Men deres pastelfarvede ro bliver rystet, da Armands søn annoncerer, at han skal giftes med datteren til den ultrakonservative senator Keeley... og de skal alle spise middag sammen!

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programme.desc: Det er ikke nemt at være enlig mor på 40. Med en datter på vej i puberteten. Og et job som tv-producer på en serie, ingen gider at se... Men ind ad døren kommer den nye unge stjerneskuespiller, Adam, og så ændrer alting sig...

programme.title: Tusind timer
programme.desc: En historie om kærlighed, identitet, om at tabe og at finde sig selv igen. Tusind timer handler om sangerinden Anna, der er sidst i tyverne og har et band sammen med guitaristen Thomas.

programme.title: Laws of Attraction
programme.desc: Dygtige skilsmisseadvokater; Audrey Woods og Daniel Rafferty; har set kærligheden gå galt i alle dens værste tilfælde - så hvor dårlige kan deres chancer være?

programme.title: Flight World War II
programme.desc: Fanget i en kamp mellem Tyske og allierede styrker, kæmper passagererne i en moderne 757 jet for at overleve efter, at de er taget tilbage i tiden til 1940. I deres forsøg på at overleve, lykkes det at påvirke historien, og slutningen på Anden Verdenskrig.

programme.title: Hangman
programme.desc: Den dekorerede pensionerede drabsdetektiv Ray Archer (Al Pacino) og hans partner, den tidligere FBI-agent Will Ruiney (Karl Urban), har til opgave at fange en ondskabsfuld seriemorder, der spiller en forvrænget version af børnespillet Hangman.

programme.title: USS Indianapolis: Men of Courage
programme.desc: Under anden verdenskrig sænkes et skib fra den amerikanske flåde af en japansk ubåd og efterlader 890 mand i et hav fuldt af hajer.

programme.title: Edison
programme.desc: En af politiets eliteenheder risikerer at blive afsløret i korruption af en ung journalist, som hurtigt opdager, at han er på dybt vand.

programme.title: Fremmed end fiktion
programme.desc: En IRS-auditor finder pludselig, at han er genstand for fortælling, som kun han kan høre: fortælling, der begynder at påvirke hele hans liv; fra hans arbejde; til hans kærlighedsinteresse; til sin død.

programme.title: The Duchess
programme.desc: En krønike om livet for aristokraten Georgiana, hertuginde af Devonshire, fra det 18. århundrede, der var æret for sit ekstravagante politiske og personlige liv.

programme.title: Promised Land
programme.desc: Dette hårde drama følger to gymnasiekammerater, Hancock og Danny, efter at de er færdige. Hancock og hans cheerleader-kæreste går videre til en middelklasse-middelmådighed, der ligger uden for rækkevidde for Danny og hans psykotiske kone Bev.

programme.desc: Fraskilte Sarah og hendes teenagedatter Elissa har endelig fundet drømmehuset! Men da de hører om fortidens massakrer i den mystiske nabovilla, sætter det en dæmper på idyllen.

programme.title: Journey's End
programme.desc: Vestfronten, 18. marts 1918. Med et massivt tysk angreb nært forestående rykker et kompagni op til sin 6-dages periode på linjen. Kompagniet ledes af den krigstrætte, hårdt sårede og alkoholiserede kaptajn Stanhope. Kompagniet slutter sig til sekondløjtnant Raleigh, lige færdig med sin træning.
